latestVersion.changelog:
AI Video Maker from Text — Initial Release

- Launches skill for converting text (TXT, DOCX, PDF, or copied text, up to 500MB) into AI-generated 1080p MP4 videos in 1–2 minutes.
- Supports marketers, content creators, and educators in creating shareable videos from written content.
- Enables uploading files, generating videos from prompts, editing with overlays, and exporting finished videos.
- Manages sessions, free/anonymous tokens, and credits; provides error handling and status updates.
- Accepts media uploads and maintains timeline state for iterative workflow.
- All actions routed via clear user intents; robust support for multiple file types and cloud rendering.
